data.raw_text:
A 21-year-old baker was seriously injured after his arm was trapped in a dough roller machine in a bakery in Barangay 179 in Maricaban, Pasay City. 

Investigation showed that the baker just finished kneading the dough and was about to clean the machine when the accident happened. 

The barangay said the bakery owner could be held accountable if the investigation shows that there’s no safety feature, like a machine guard, attached to the dough roller. 

Meanwhile, the bakery owner said they would take care of the baker's hospital treatment.
